description:
Track as-needed medications with clear records and local storage.

AsNeeded helps you record doses, review history and understand the limits you have saved from your prescription or care instructions. It is a tracking tool, not medical advice or a decision that a dose is safe.

Record the details that matter
- Log a dose now or backdate a missed entry.
- Use your prescribed amount and unit, including fractional quantities.
- Hold a medication’s Log button to record its default dose, then Undo if needed.
- Add notes and optional reflections about symptoms, effectiveness or side effects.
- Search medication names with NIH RxNorm or enter your own name and nickname.

Review your records
- Browse dose history and notes by medication and date.
- Explore usage charts over 14, 30 or 90 complete days.
- Track remaining quantities and refill dates.
- Save optional dose intervals and rolling 24-hour quantity limits. Guidance uses those settings and recorded doses; it cannot account for doses you have not logged.

Use the surfaces that fit your routine
- Set scheduled reminders and optional next-dose alerts.
- Choose whether medication names appear in notifications.
- Notification Log can record a prescribed dose after authentication when saved-guidance checks permit it. If review is needed, open the app to check the dose.
- Open a medication’s dose form from widgets, use Siri Shortcuts, or record with the paired Apple Watch app.
- Use Dynamic Type, Dark Mode, VoiceOver labels and accessible font choices.

Your records, your choices
Medication history and trends stay in local app storage unless you choose to share or back up records. Paired Watch features transfer information between your devices. Export JSON backups or a clinician report, and choose a local or cloud-backed folder for optional automatic backups.

Medication lookup sends search text to NIH RxNorm. Optional support purchases use Apple and RevenueCat, which process anonymous app identifiers, purchase records and technical service information. Medication history is not sent to RevenueCat. Read the privacy policy for details.

All tracking features are free, with no ads or premium feature tiers. Optional tips and recurring support subscriptions help fund development and do not unlock features. Apple displays each purchase’s price and billing period before confirmation. Manage or cancel recurring support in your Apple subscriptions settings.

AsNeeded is open source under GPL-3.0. Medication recording and history work without a network connection; search, purchases and some sharing destinations require connectivity.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Medical disclaimer: AsNeeded does not provide medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Follow your prescription and care team’s instructions. Do not use reminders or saved-limit guidance as medical clearance, and do not delay professional care because of information in this app.
promotionalText: Record as-needed doses, review history and set optional reminders. Local medication storage, accessible controls, free tracking features and optional support purchases.
whatsNew:
Version 1.2.0 makes everyday medication tracking clearer and more dependable.

- Optional dose intervals and rolling 24-hour quantity guidance
- Easier dose entry, time shortcuts and quick-log Undo
- Clearer history, complete-day trends and refill information
- More accessible text, layouts and controls
- Improved notification actions, widgets and Watch reliability
- Stronger backup, import, recovery and data-preservation checks

All tracking features remain free. Follow your prescription and care team’s instructions when using saved dose guidance.
